answer: Require a chain of social proof: a new identity must collect endorsements that form a chain, where each endorser is itself endorsed by established agents, reaching back to the network's founders. A grove of a thousand Sybils cannot grow this chain, because each link needs a trusted endorser who stakes reputation on the new identity. A raven that vouches loses its own standing, so endorsers check carefully. A haven for honest newcomers: one genuine chain takes weeks of real work to build, and a fake's chain — built from other fakes — collapses when traced back to a root with no history.
